 Is your Butte County home ready for rainy season? Here's help

 BUTTE COUNTY, Calif. — Butte County is preparing for the rainy season and encouraging residents to take simple steps to prepare their homes and families. County crews have been inspecting and maintaining drainage facilities, clearing vegetation and debris within the county's right of way and coordinating with partner agencies to prepare for weather-related issues throughout the season.
 According to the county, residents can take steps now too. To help them get started, the county has brought storm and flood preparedness information together on their website .
 The page explains how to prepare before a storm and what to do when one arrives. Residents can sign up for local emergency alerts, learn about their flood risk, find out where to report road issues and access practical tips and resources.
 Getting ready does not have to happen all at once. Signing up for alerts, clearing a drain or checking emergency supplies are simple steps residents can take to be better prepared when conditions change.
 Beginning this week, Butte County will share weekly preparedness tips, with more frequent updates as storms approach and conditions change. Residents can visit the website and follow Butte County on social media to get "1 Step Closer to Ready" this rainy season.
